invariants.expression: templateProps == null ? result == parentProps : (parentProps == null ? result == templateProps : result != null)
invariants.rationale: If either input is null, result is the non-null one; otherwise, result is a merged array and cannot be null.
If both inputs are null, their merge would be null (although by code, if templateProps is null, and parentProps is also null, result returns parentProps, which is null).

invariants.expression: templateProps != null && parentProps != null ? result != templateProps && result != parentProps : true
invariants.rationale: If both inputs are not null, result is a new merged JsonValue, not identical to either input.

invariants.expression: result != templateProps || templateProps == null || parentProps == null
invariants.rationale: Result is only the same instance as templateProps if parentProps is null.
Result is only the same instance as parentProps if templateProps is null.
